correctness.rationale: Hibi straightening relations split into exactly two Boolean blocks with one shared coordinate. Boolean Hibi rings equal affine Segre cone coordinate rings, yielding a genuine scheme-theoretic fiber product. At nonzero rank-one tensors the differential of the corner coordinate vanishes exactly when at least two designated factors vanish. At one zero factor cone the tangent excess is 2^m-m-1, positive iff m>=2. These three cases exhaust the nonzero projective cone. Irreducibility/maximality follow from the Segre divisor and join loci; analytic elimination at a general boundary yields the affine Segre cone, and two two-factor products yield an ordinary threefold node at a general mixed component. Degree of Segre gives m! multiplicity. Actual included finite checker was rerun and matched its output for 1,815 tensor representatives over two primes. Special-point and nonreduced scheme details are not proved and are not claimed.

originality.rationale: The all-Hibi singular orbit criteria are explicitly recognized as dominant general prior work for orbit singularity detection. The new specialized theorem derives exact and complete maximal component geometry, count, codimensions, and generic analytic types for the two-antichain ordinal-sum family. Targeted primary full-text inspections and published-record searches did not locate equivalent complete statements; residual indexing/implicit-specialization risk remains. This is not an independence claim.

value.rationale: The natural complete-bipartite-comparability height-two poset family gives a meaningful infinite algebraic-geometric stratification problem: exact numbers, dimensions, projective geometries of all singular components and local analytic transverse models. The count changes from a unique isolated singularity in the one-sided singleton case to a+b+C(a,2)C(b,2) positive-dimensional strata when both sides are at least two; for a=b=2 it yields five singular lines in a two-quadric complete intersection. Explicit germ descriptions can inform local resolutions and singular cohomology questions. This is not a random narrow invariant, merely routine numeric increment, or a claim about more general posets.
